config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName,
  ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment'] as Env,
  count() as OccurrenceCount,
  LogAttributes['msg'] As LogMessage
FROM
  default.otel_logs
WHERE
  (
    Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(1784898522413)
    AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(1784902122413)
  )
  AND (
    toStartOfFiveMinutes(Timestamp) >= toStartOfFiveMinutes(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(1784898522413))
    AND toStartOfFiveMinutes(Timestamp) <= toStartOfFiveMinutes(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(1784902122413))
  )
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY
  ServiceName, Env, LogMessage
ORDER BY
  OccurrenceCount Desc
LIMIT
  200
